name: Badger Rinse
tagline: The operating system for people who take grime personally.
positioning: Badger Rinse runs the boring parts of a one-person pressure-washing and industrial cleaning hustle so you can get back to blasting things.

hero.h1: Grime doesn't schedule itself. Now it kind of does.
hero.sub: Badger Rinse is the scheduling, quoting, and before/after proof app for solo pressure-washers, detailers, and degreasing fanatics who'd rather clean than do paperwork.

features.title: Quote in the driveway
features.description: Snap the mildew, pick a surface, and Badger Rinse spits out a square-footage quote before the homeowner finishes their coffee. Send it as a text, get paid.

features.title: Before/after that pays
features.description: Auto-tag paired shots per job so the grimy 'before' never gets lost. Customers approve from their phone; you get a review request that actually sends itself.

features.title: Chemical dilution calculator
features.description: Stop eyeballing the SH. Enter tank size and target mix, get exact ratios and a soft warning before you nuke someone's boxwoods.

features.title: Route that respects gas prices
features.description: Cluster jobs by zip and drive time so you're not crossing town four times. Fewer miles, more driveways, same day.

features.title: Invoices, deposits, done
features.description: Deposit up front, balance on completion, card or ACH. Late payers get a polite nudge from the badger, not from you.

features.title: Recurring reminders
features.description: Gutters and fleets get dirty on a schedule. Auto-rebook seasonal clients and fill next month before it's empty.

testimonials.quote: I used to lose two evenings a week to quotes and invoices. Badger Rinse gave me those evenings back and I still charge more, because the before/after proof does the arguing for me.
testimonials.name: Marcus Deel

testimonials.quote: The dilution calculator alone paid for a year. I stopped over-mixing surfactant and my chemical bill dropped like a rock. Also I killed zero plants last season.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramachandran

testimonials.quote: Routing sounds boring until you realize it's diesel money. I fit two extra fleet accounts into my Tuesdays without adding a single hour.
testimonials.name: Dale Fontaine

pricing.blurb: For side-hustlers testing whether grime pays the bills.
For the one-truck pro doing this full time.
For when 'solo' quietly became a small crew.

homepage.footerBlurb: Badger Rinse. Built for people who see a stained driveway and feel a calling. Free to start, faster to get paid.
